ITEM 1 | Pale off-white, creamy, soft mass with a lumpy, slightly ridged surface, piled on the left half of the plate. It holds a rounded mound shape, is matte with slight sheen, and sits about 3 cm high across roughly 200 cm² of plate. | 180
ITEM 2 | Bright orange cubes about 1.5 to 2 cm per side, with matte, slightly firm surfaces and a few darker caramelized edges. They are scattered on the right side and at the base of the pale mass. | 50
ITEM 3 | Dark brown, browned cubes about 1.5 to 2 cm per side, with glossy, slightly sticky-looking surfaces and charred or caramelized edges. They are mixed among the orange cubes on the right side. | 40
ITEM 4 | Small golden-yellow glossy bits, about 0.5 to 1 cm, lodged between the dark brown cubes and near the orange pieces, with a slightly translucent sheen. | 10
